name: ecoimpact-mobile
description: EcoImpact sustainable living app for web, Android and iOS

scripts.preview: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 -d dist
scripts.android:add: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
